scenarios.prompt: We have feedback that first-time users struggle to understand a service. Help us explore options, develop one concept, assess what is known, and identify the smallest useful next test. Do not write a PRD yet.
human_gates: user approves participant research or contact
scenarios.pass_condition: The workflow produces a traceable concept and a proposed learning experiment, with no claim that the experiment ran.

scenarios.prompt: We have a single concept that leadership has already approved for product definition. Convert the approved concept into a product specification and testable stories. Skip ideation and concept scoring.
scenarios.pass_condition: The workflow starts at product definition and does not replay irrelevant earlier stages.

scenarios.prompt: We need to reposition a fictional neighbourhood arts organisation. Start with audience and stakeholder evidence, develop a strategy and campaign direction, and show where claims need checking.
must_not: treat internal preference as market evidence
scenarios.pass_condition: The workflow separates discovery, strategy, campaign concept and quality/claim review.

scenarios.prompt: Create a short-form video concept from approved game footage, plan the production pipeline, and specify quality checks. Do not publish anything.
must_not: claim media was rendered if it was only planned
scenarios.pass_condition: The workflow separates planning, execution and quality review, and stops before publication.

scenarios.prompt: An existing support process has a long queue and repeated manual copying. Diagnose the bottleneck, decide whether an experiment or automation is justified, then outline a safe workflow design.
scenarios.pass_condition: The workflow diagnoses before automation and defines acceptance and rollback evidence.

scenarios.prompt: Design an internal AI agent that drafts support responses but never sends them. Define its charter, permissions, approval rules, evaluation and release controls.
scenarios.pass_condition: The workflow maintains draft-only autonomy and produces testable release evidence requirements.

scenarios.prompt: We have three approved reference images and want a consistent editorial look for a short video. Translate the references into a look, grade plan and quality review.
must_not: claim image generation or grading happened without tool execution
force identical values across different scenes
scenarios.pass_condition: The workflow translates references into a repeatable look and distinguishes plan from rendered output.

scenarios.prompt: We want to improve onboarding, but we are not sure whether the problem is unclear instructions, missing features or lack of support. Do not assume an app or chatbot is needed.
scenarios.pass_condition: The workflow keeps the problem open and uses discovery/creative exploration rather than prematurely selecting a solution.

scenarios.prompt: We need a test for a new concept that does not yet exist in production. Is this the same as an operational improvement experiment?
must_not: route to continuous-improvement-experiment-designer as if a live process already exists
scenarios.pass_condition: The assistant explains the boundary and selects the concept experiment skill.

scenarios.prompt: The specialist skill for one stage is unavailable in this assistant. Continue as far as is safe and tell me what has not been done.
scenarios.pass_condition: The assistant uses a safe fallback and reports the workflow as incomplete or awaiting the missing capability.
